name: Cache
description: Cache artifacts like dependencies and build outputs to a Namespace Cloud cache volume to improve workflow execution time.

spacectl-version.description: Version of spacectl CLI to use (e.g., '0.1.0' or 'latest'). If not specified, uses existing binary or fetches latest.

spacectl-system-binary.description: Whether to use an existing spacectl binary. Options: 'prefer' (default), 'require', 'ignore'.

github-token.description: GitHub token for API requests to fetch space releases

fail-on-cache-miss.description: Fail the workflow if cache entry is not found

detect.description: A list of cache modes you want to enable, only if detected. Set to 'true' to detect all available cache modes based on the environment. See `cache` for a list o

cache.description: A list of cache modes to enable. Supported options are 'apt,brew,bun,cocoapods,composer,deno,go,golangci-lint,gradle,maven,mise,nix,playwright,pnpm,poetry,pytho

path.description: A list of files, directories, and wildcard patterns to cache and restore
